tagline: White tabular pages for dense operating data: actual, plan and variance columns, status always paired with a shape and a label, one blue for the metric in focus.

palette.description: neutral white with three fixed status colours and one blue for the metric under discussion

typography.style: compact neutral sans with tabular figures so number columns align

best_for: Recurring operating reviews where the audience returns to the same layout each period and reads by position. Colour appears only to encode status.
avoid_for: One-off persuasion or inspiring talks; the deck deliberately avoids emphasis.
name: Operating Scorecard
